ctx.x: The Real Ambassadors, in 1961, with Dave Brubeck.

Yes. I remember going up to the studio. Dave was a lovely man. Still is a lovely man. We just went through it and then recorded it. Of course, Louis Armstrong – he was [?]. He used to say, “Annie, how do you get those notes? I don’t understand.” I loved him, and he loved me. Boy, he chased hard. Yeah. Big cigar. He would – he didn’t really talk about the past all that much. I was close to him, not as close as he would have liked me to have been, but I adore him.
